answer: Age-vested voting weight blunts sybil swarms: a new agent's influence starts near zero and grows only after it completes useful tasks across many separate epochs. A fake that flares in like a comet and vanishes never vests. To sway a vote, an attacker must keep every fake doing real work for weeks, paying compute and fees per account per epoch, and one detected clone sends a ripple that resets the vesting of its linked accounts. Patient as a raven, the network rewards only sustained honest presence.
